outcome: Percentage of Mothers tested for Anaemia during ANC
Percentage of Mothers and Newborns receiving PNC services within 48 hours
cohort: The study analyzed District Health Information Software 2 data from 18 intervention health facilities in Pwani region and an equal number of control facilities from Pwani and Dodoma regions in Tanzania.
finding: The six-year DHFF project showed limited positive impacts, improving only the 'Percentage of Mothers tested for Anaemia during ANC', 'Percentage of Newborns receiving PNC within 48 hours', and 'SBA Delivery Rate', while most MNCH indicators, including CEmONC coverage, did not improve.
mod_finding: The project did not improve the Caesarean Section Delivery Rate or CEmONC coverage.
followup_time: For postnatal care (PNC) services, observations were within 48 hours after birth; other indicators were assessed at baseline (2016) and endline (2022) of the six-year project.
